briefing.text: The Hunger Games prequel opened to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide.
Nvidia's board opened a CEO search and says it will not bring Jensen Huang back.
An Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis.
GTA VI's $3.79 billion first day still leads gaming, with no Black Friday discount.
The AI-led sell-off spread to crypto, with Bitcoin falling to about $60,000.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel topped the weekend with a $120 million North American opening and $105 million overseas, Flickering Myth reports.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: It is the franchise's fourth-biggest global debut and the second-biggest North American prequel opening after Rogue One. It also beat The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes' $100.8 million debut.
stories.next: Watch for how well it holds over the Thanksgiving holiday week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It beat Lionsgate's own $85 million weekend forecast.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson are said to have cameos.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opened the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.bottom: is winning its own contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
stories.summary: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest entertainment launches ever, and a test for the whole console market.
stories.happened: Take-Two estimates it took $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, the biggest entertainment launch yet. It came out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and GameRant says Take-Two has ruled out direct Black Friday discounts.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's next update on sales and any news on a PC version.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The day-one figure beats GTA V's launch several times over.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans waited 13 years since GTA V.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its 99 on Metacritic ties the highest score the site lists.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive and also made Red Dead Redemption.

meme.bottom: for a game about doing crimes for money
meme.take: GTA VI earns in one day what its characters spend a whole campaign trying to steal.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.
stories.why: The Riemann Hypothesis is one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics, so a proof would be historic.
stories.happened: TNW, citing Bloomberg, presents it as the researcher's own claim. The Guardian says the work took six weeks, and an AI digest reports a Lean formal proof of about 17 million lines was checked on November 21.
stories.next: Watch for reviews by independent mathematicians and whether a paper goes to peer review.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI-assisted proof of a problem this famous would be a first.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is one of the Clay Institute's million-dollar Millennium Prize Problems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The formal proof is reported at about 17 million lines.

stories.background: Posed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the zeros of the zeta function, which are tied to how primes are spread.

meme.bottom: met a chatbot with six weeks free
meme.take: Riemann waited 167 years for a proof and is now waiting for peer review like everyone else.

stories.title: Nvidia opens a CEO search as its board rules out Jensen Huang's return
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a new CEO and says it does not plan to reinstate Huang, after shares fell 14% on Friday.
stories.why: Nvidia's chips power most of the AI boom, so turmoil there affects the whole industry.
stories.happened: Shares closed at $125.53 on November 20, about 48% below their October 6 record, 24/7 Wall St. reports. Reuters reported the SEC is examining possible accounting issues, which is unconfirmed.
stories.next: Watch for the CEO search, Nvidia's response on the SEC report and congressional interviews on December 1 and 2.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Shares sit about 48% below their October record.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Huang co-founded Nvidia and led it for over 30 years.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Several regulators are looking at the company.

stories.background: Nvidia makes the GPUs behind most AI models. Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO after Huang resigned in November.

meme.bottom: the interview includes a stock chart
meme.take: Nvidia's board wants a CEO who can calm investors, which is a short list.

stories.title: Questions grow over Anthropic's IPO as its shares keep sliding
stories.summary: The FT asks whether Anthropic and its bankers got the IPO wrong, after weak trading and a quick use of the option to sell extra shares.
stories.why: The listing is the first big test of how public markets value a frontier AI company.
stories.happened: Shares priced at $83 opened at $111.50 and fell about 9% on day two. Reuters reports Anthropic limited some of its 22 underwriters to four senior bankers and sought six-month limits on their work with AI rivals.
stories.next: Watch for how the shares trade this week and the December 15 lock-up release.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It was described as the largest US listing on record.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Some bankers reportedly chafed at the unusual limits on deal teams.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The slide comes during a wider tech sell-off.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

meme.top: The IPO had strict rules for bankers
meme.bottom: and none for the share price
meme.take: Anthropic controlled who worked on its IPO, but not who sold afterwards.

stories.title: AI-led sell-off deepens, dragging Bitcoin to a 20-week low near $60,000
stories.summary: After the Nasdaq's 5.28% fall on November 20, the tech sell-off has spread, with Bitcoin dropping to about $60,000, TechJuice reports.
stories.why: Many savers and retirement funds hold the big tech stocks that have led markets for years.
stories.happened: The Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow had their worst week since April 2025. TechJuice ties Bitcoin's slide to doubts about AI firms after Anthropic's share reversal. UBS still expects AI investment of $1.4 trillion in 2027.
stories.next: Watch for whether Monday's trading steadies or extends last week's losses.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The Nasdaq erased its 2026 gain in one session.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Investors are questioning whether AI spending will pay off.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: The selling has spread from tech stocks to crypto.

stories.background: A correction means a fall of 10% or more from a recent high. The Nasdaq is heavy with tech companies.

meme.bottom: then Bitcoin asked to join in
meme.take: The AI trade is cooling so fast that even Bitcoin has decided to be cautious.

stories.title: Amazon is said to be close to buying video AI startup Decart for $7.5 billion
stories.summary: The FT reports Amazon is in advanced talks to buy Israeli video-model startup Decart for about $7.5 billion, with a deal possible this week.
stories.why: It would be one of the largest AI startup takeovers and a big bet on AI-generated video.
stories.happened: The FT cites people familiar with the talks, and The Information also reported them on Saturday. Neither company has confirmed a deal.
stories.next: Watch for an official announcement, or signs that the talks have stalled.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The price is reported at about $7.5 billion.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Big tech firms are racing to own video generation models.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Large companies keep buying AI startups outright.

stories.background: Decart is an Israeli startup that builds AI models for generating video. Amazon also runs AWS, the largest cloud business.

meme.top: Amazon wants AI that makes video
meme.bottom: and it is willing to pay retail
meme.take: Amazon is reportedly adding a $7.5 billion video startup to its basket.

stories.title: South Korea's education minister resigns over AI cheating in university exams
stories.summary: South Korea's education minister has resigned after a scandal over AI-assisted cheating in university entrance exams, The Guardian reports.
stories.why: Schools everywhere are struggling to stop AI tools being used in tests.
stories.happened: The Guardian reports the minister stepped down on Sunday as the cheating scandal spread through the university exam system.
stories.next: Watch for changes to exam security and who is named as the new minister.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: A cabinet minister has lost the job over it.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI cheating is a growing worry for schools worldwide.

stories.background: South Korea's national college entrance exam, the Suneung, largely decides which universities students can enter.

meme.top: AI was meant to help with homework
meme.bottom: not sit the entrance exam
meme.take: South Korea learns the hardest exam in the country is now keeping AI out of it.

stories.title: Apple is said to plan an iPhone 18, iPhone 18e and new Macs for February or March
stories.summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple plans an iPhone 18e, iPhone 18, entry iPad, MacBook Neo and MacBook Air for around February or March.
stories.why: Apple usually launches its main iPhones in September, so a spring iPhone 18 would be a change.
stories.happened: MacRumors, citing Gurman, says the iPhone 18 models are expected to use an A20 chip with 9GB of RAM and the MacBook Air an M6. An iPhone Air 2, iPad Air and iPad Pro are said to follow later in the first half of 2027.
stories.next: Watch for Apple's own announcements and more leaks of the devices.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple's iPhone is the world's best-known phone.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It points to a split launch for the iPhone 18 range.

stories.background: Mark Gurman is a Bloomberg reporter with a long record of accurate reports on Apple's plans.

meme.bottom: its specs are already old news
meme.take: Apple's spring line-up is so well leaked it may arrive pre-reviewed.

stories.title: Google shares are down 18% since it reported a sharp slowdown in search ads
stories.summary: The Information reports Google shares have fallen 18% since the company disclosed a sharp slowdown in search-ad growth, partly linked to AI.
stories.why: Search ads are Google's main source of profit and help pay for its AI spending.
stories.happened: The Information links part of the slowdown to Google's own AI features in search. It also looks at the knock-on effect for Apple's services business, which earns money from Google's search deal.
stories.next: Watch for Google's next earnings and any changes to how ads appear in AI answers.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Search ads are Google's biggest business.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: Apple earns billions from Google's search deal.

stories.background: Google, owned by Alphabet, runs the world's most used search engine.

meme.bottom: and the ad quietly loses its job
meme.take: Google built an AI so helpful that it is now competing with Google.

stories.title: GTA VI fans are reportedly review-bombing the Ocarina of Time remake
stories.summary: Nintendo Life reports the Ocarina of Time remake's positive user score has come under fire, reportedly from GTA VI fans.
stories.why: Fan rivalries spilling into review scores make those scores harder to trust.
stories.happened: GTA VI holds a 99 on Metacritic, tied with the original Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game the site lists. GTA VI's own user score had opened at 5.2 amid review-bombing claims.
stories.next: Watch for whether Metacritic steps in on either game's user reviews.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Two of the highest-rated games ever are pitted against each other.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: User scores are being used as a weapon in fan arguments.

stories.background: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) has long been the highest-rated game on Metacritic.

meme.bottom: the fans are settling it by vandalism
meme.take: GTA VI fans reportedly went after a Zelda game, which is the most GTA way to handle a tie.

stories.title: Cleverbridge says hackers copied card numbers and CVVs from its platform
stories.summary: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge, whose clients include Red Hat and Sony, says a third party copied stored payment card data, including CVVs.
stories.why: Card numbers with security codes can be used for fraud, so buyers may need new cards.
stories.happened: It detected the activity on November 4 and began notifying customers on November 20. A notice seen by BleepingComputer says card numbers, expiry dates and CVVs were copied, but not names or billing details.
stories.next: Watch for the number of affected customers and which software brands' buyers were hit.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its clients include Red Hat, Sony and Veeam.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Full card details are enough for online fraud.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes just before Black Friday shopping.

stories.background: Cleverbridge handles online payments for software and subscription companies.

meme.bottom: the one number meant to be forgotten
meme.take: Cleverbridge learned the three digits on the back are meant to be forgotten, not filed.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 models get to the point but admit less doubt, test finds
stories.summary: The Decoder reports OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give shorter, more direct answers but score lower than Claude on transparency.
stories.why: How openly a model flags doubt affects how far people can trust its answers.
stories.happened: The models launched last week in ChatGPT and Codex, with API access. Astra's API price is reported at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output, a 20% cut on earlier rates.
stories.next: Watch for OpenAI's response and further independent tests of the models.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The comparison is with Anthropic's Claude.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Astra's API price fell by a reported 20%.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Labs are tuning models to give shorter answers.

stories.background: OpenAI is the company behind ChatGPT. Codex is its coding assistant.

meme.bottom: which is also how bluffing works
meme.take: OpenAI trimmed its models' answers, and the first thing cut was 'I'm not sure'.

stats.label: Astra API, per M input tokens

stories.title: TfL says attackers accessed data of 265,000 Oyster photocard holders
stories.summary: Transport for London says about 265,000 Oyster photocard accounts, including children's Zip cards and 60+ cards, had personal details exposed.
stories.why: Dates of birth and security answers can be used to break into other accounts.
stories.happened: Suspicious activity was found on November 16 and the photocard site was taken offline. TfL says emails, phone numbers, addresses, dates of birth and security answers were exposed, but not passwords or cards.
stories.next: Watch for the ICO's response and when TfL brings photocard accounts back online.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 265,000 accounts are affected.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Security questions are hard to change once leaked.

drivers.label: History
drivers.text: TfL was also hit by a costly cyberattack in 2024.

stories.background: Transport for London runs the city's buses, Underground and other services. Oyster is its travel card.

meme.bottom: for unplanned engineering works
meme.take: TfL found its photocard site needed engineering works more urgently than the Tube.

stories.title: Apple's reported Mac AI agent may not arrive until late 2027
stories.summary: Apple is said to be building an agent that controls apps, browses and codes, but Digital Trends reports it may not arrive until the end of 2027.
stories.why: An agent built into the Mac would bring AI that acts for you to millions of computers.
stories.happened: Bloomberg first reported the project on November 19 from a job listing Apple later removed. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman returned to it on Sunday, and Google has already given Gemini control of Mac apps.
stories.next: Watch for whether Apple shows any agent features at its next software event.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple has not announced the product, so every detail comes from the listing.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Google gave Gemini control of Macs the same day.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Computer-using agents are the current race among AI companies.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone and Mac and launched its Apple Intelligence features in 2024.

meme.bottom: the agent would have done it faster
meme.take: Apple's secret AI agent was revealed by the one thing agents cannot hide from: recruiting.

stories.title: Bipartisan US governors ask Washington to set rules for the most powerful AI
stories.summary: A bipartisan group of US governors wants federal rules for the most powerful AI systems, while keeping states' power to protect people.
stories.why: Whether states or Washington write AI rules decides how strict they are across the country.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reports the governors want national rules for frontier systems but say states must still be able to protect consumers, workers and children. Four senators have also proposed a bill on AI disclosure by public companies.
stories.next: Watch for whether Congress takes up federal rules for frontier AI.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: States and Washington are both trying to set AI rules.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes as AI companies become huge public firms.

stories.background: Several US states, including California and Colorado, have passed their own AI laws in recent years.

meme.bottom: with room for fifty more
meme.take: US governors agree AI needs one national rulebook, with fifty appendices.

stories.title: Documentary You Can See Everything passes $100 million worldwide
stories.summary: The documentary has crossed $100 million worldwide on a reported $7 million budget, adding $9 million as its global rollout began.
stories.why: Documentaries almost never reach blockbuster numbers, so a hit this size stands out.
stories.happened: Flickering Myth reports $93.4 million of the total comes from North America. The $9 million weekend came as the film started opening in more countries.
stories.next: Watch for how it performs as it opens in more markets.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It has earned about 14 times its reported budget.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Very few documentaries have passed $100 million.

stories.background: Most documentaries open in a small number of cinemas or go straight to streaming.

meme.bottom: and it is outgrossing explosions
meme.take: A $7 million documentary passed $100 million, and studios are suddenly curious about facts.

stories.title: Signal blocks mobile screenshots of chats to keep out AI assistants
stories.summary: Signal is restricting screenshots on mobile and blocking assistants such as Siri and Gemini from capturing chats, calling AI agents a threat to privacy.
stories.why: AI assistants that read screens could see messages people expect to stay private.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports Signal described AI agents as an existential threat to privacy. BleepingComputer reports the block will cover Siri and Gemini on iOS and Android.
stories.next: Watch for how Apple and Google respond and whether other messaging apps follow.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Assistants that read screens could expose private chats.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It puts Signal at odds with Apple's and Google's assistants.

stories.background: Signal is an encrypted messaging app run by a non-profit and known for its focus on privacy.

meme.top: Your assistant wanted to read chats
meme.bottom: Signal said no on your behalf
meme.take: Signal now treats AI assistants the way it treats everyone else: as someone listening in.

stories.title: OpenRouter drops three AI providers after researchers find stolen keys
stories.summary: OpenRouter removed three inference providers and 125 endpoints from its zero-data-retention list after Dragos found compromised providers.
stories.why: Developers often send private data through cheap AI providers without knowing who runs them.
stories.happened: Dragos sent about two million fake AI requests and found at least three compromised providers and hundreds of stolen AWS keys, The Decoder reports. It says some cheap hosts could snoop on users.
stories.next: Watch for which providers are named and whether other AI routers tighten their checks.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: User prompts may have been seen by unknown parties.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Researchers sent two million test requests.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI supply chains are a new target for attackers.

stories.background: OpenRouter lets developers reach many AI models from different providers through a single API.

meme.top: The budget AI host kept no data
meme.bottom: it simply shared it
meme.take: Some cheap AI hosts offered zero data retention and generous data distribution.

stories.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
stories.summary: The Blade Runner series lands on Prime Video on November 25 as an eight-episode binge release, NewsBeep's weekly TV schedule lists.
stories.why: It continues one of science fiction's most influential film series on television.
stories.happened: It is one of the biggest streaming arrivals of Thanksgiving week. The Rings of Power season 3 finale lands on the same service a day earlier, and Netflix has The Hunting Wives season 2 on Thanksgiving.
stories.next: Watch for reviews once all the episodes are out.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Blade Runner (1982) is a cult science fiction classic.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: All episodes drop just before the holiday weekend.

stories.background: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film based on a Philip K. Dick novel. A sequel, Blade Runner 2049, followed in 2017.

meme.top: The first film was set in 2019
meme.bottom: so 2099 feels about right
meme.take: Blade Runner reaches 2099, still asking about androids, now in eight episodes.

stories.title: Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is now a structurally complete draft
stories.summary: In his autumn newsletter, Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is progressing well as a structurally complete draft, with an update on Chapter 7 too.
stories.why: Deltarune has a devoted fanbase that tracks every development update closely.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life reported the newsletter on November 20. No release date was given for either chapter.
stories.next: Watch for a release window for Chapter 6.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans follow each newsletter for clues.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Toby Fox created the cult indie hit Undertale.

stories.background: Deltarune is a role-playing game by Toby Fox, creator of 2015's Undertale. It is being released in chapters.

meme.bottom: fans have started counting drafts
meme.take: Toby Fox calls Chapter 6 structurally complete, which fans will read as a release date.

stories.title: Microsoft is retiring its To Do app and pointing users to Planner
stories.summary: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do apps next year, with Planner as the replacement, which needs a Microsoft 365 business or education licence.
stories.why: Many people rely on To Do for everyday lists across their devices.
stories.happened: Windows Central argues it shows Microsoft's shrinking consumer software line-up, after Wunderlist, Skype and Cortana were shut down. The column gives no exact retirement date.
stories.next: Watch for the retirement date and any free option for home users.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Home users may need a work licence for the replacement.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: To Do grew out of Wunderlist, which Microsoft bought in 2015.

stories.background: Microsoft To Do is a free list app that Microsoft built from Wunderlist.

meme.bottom: it was the last item on the list
meme.take: Microsoft To Do has finally been crossed off, by Microsoft.

stories.title: Bessent says US chip limits on China are enough, after House licence report
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says current limits on Nvidia chips to China are sufficient, after a House report on approved sales.
stories.why: It shows how many advanced chips reached China while Washington was publicly tightening the rules.
stories.happened: The House Foreign Affairs Committee report says Commerce approved 879,868 chips across 21 applications as of May 11. Alibaba got 75,000 and Tencent 150,000; the Pentagon lists both as having military ties, AP reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether Congress pushes for tighter export rules despite the Treasury's view.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Approvals cover hundreds of thousands of advanced chips.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chips are central to the US-China contest over AI.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The Treasury Secretary has now weighed in.

stories.background: The US has limited exports of advanced AI chips to China since 2022, citing national security.

meme.top: Strict limits on chips to China
meme.bottom: 879,868 approved exceptions
meme.take: The export rules were very strict, apart from the 879,868 times they were not.

stories.title: I Play Rocky takes second with $9.3 million in its wide expansion
stories.summary: Peter Farrelly's Stallone biopic expanded from limited release to earn $9.3 million and finish second, Flickering Myth reports.
stories.why: A crowd-pleasing film about making Rocky could become counter-programming to the Hunger Games prequel.
stories.happened: That fell short of BoxOfficePro's $15 million to $20 million forecast for the weekend. The film went in with a 98% audience score and an 87% critic score.
stories.next: Watch for whether word of mouth carries it through Thanksgiving.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Rocky is one of cinema's best-known underdog stories.

drivers.label: Word of mouth
drivers.text: Its audience score is 98%.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens wide against the Hunger Games prequel.

stories.background: Rocky (1976) was written by and starred Sylvester Stallone and won the Oscar for best picture.

meme.bottom: finished second, as underdogs do
meme.take: I Play Rocky took second place, which is the most Rocky result possible.

stories.title: Persona 6 has no date, but a website update fuels Game Awards trailer talk
stories.summary: Atlus says Persona 6 has no release date yet, while an update to its web domain has fans expecting a trailer at The Game Awards on December 10.
stories.why: Persona is one of the most popular Japanese role-playing series, and fans have waited years for a new main entry.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life reports Atlus also said the wait for Persona 7 will be shorter. MyNintendoNews notes a Persona 4 Revival domain update came a month before its trailer. Nothing has been announced.
stories.next: Watch for The Game Awards on December 10 and any teasers from Atlus before then.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Persona 5 came out in 2016 in Japan.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Awards are under three weeks away.

stories.background: Atlus is a Japanese studio owned by Sega that makes the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series.

meme.bottom: a whole fandom cleared its December
meme.take: Persona fans have turned domain records into the most closely read documents in gaming.

stories.title: Extortion group claims leak of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customer data
stories.summary: A group called n0n claims it stole data tied to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan, and the banks say marketing data at vendors was exposed.
stories.why: Data linked to three of the biggest names in payments can fuel convincing phishing scams against customers.
stories.happened: Reuters reported leaked JPMorgan records with over 16,000 customer emails, which it could not verify. JPMorgan says marketing data at vendors was accessed. Visa says its systems and card data were not affected.
stories.next: Watch for official customer notifications and any confirmed count of people affected.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It involves three of the largest payment and banking firms.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Leaked names and emails are often used for phishing.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers increasingly go after vendors instead of the main company.

stories.background: Supply-chain breaches happen when attackers reach a company's data through a supplier or contractor.

meme.bottom: and got the marketing list
meme.take: Breach shows even bank vaults are only as strong as the newsletter vendor.

stories.title: Microsoft says an Entra Connect Health flaw was used to take tenant data
stories.summary: Microsoft has disclosed that attackers exploited a flaw in its Entra Connect Health API to reach tenant metadata, including admin emails, reports say.
stories.why: Entra is how many companies sign staff into Microsoft 365, so flaws there draw close attention.
stories.happened: BleepingComputer reports the flaw was exploited to steal tenant data. Several outlets report the exposed data included tenant metadata and administrator email addresses.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's guidance to admins and the number of tenants affected.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Microsoft's identity service is used by a huge number of businesses.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Admin emails are valuable for targeted phishing.

stories.background: Microsoft Entra, formerly Azure Active Directory, manages sign-in and identity for businesses.

meme.bottom: was the one that needed a check-up
meme.take: Microsoft's Connect Health tool turned out to be the patient.

stories.title: Lenders back SpaceX's $43 billion GPU deal but worry the chips could go to orbit
stories.summary: Tom's Hardware reports lenders funding a $43 billion Nvidia GPU lease for SpaceX worry the hardware could be hard to reclaim if sent to space.
stories.why: It shows how far lenders will stretch to fund the AI chip boom.
stories.happened: A separate company buys the chips and SpaceX makes quarterly payments under a five-year lease. The report says the lease may lack a written promise that the chips stay on Earth. Reuters had put the notes at about $44 billion.
stories.next: Watch for how SpaceX plans to use the chips and whether the terms change.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The deal is reported at about $43 billion.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Collateral that could leave the planet is new for lenders.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Lenders are funding more AI chip purchases directly.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket and satellite internet company. Apollo is a large private credit firm.

meme.top: The bank wants its GPUs back
meme.bottom: if it can reach them
meme.take: Lenders have found the one repossession problem a tow truck cannot solve.

stories.title: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade airs on NBC this Thursday
stories.summary: NBC will air the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade on November 26 at 8:30 a.m., leading the holiday's TV schedule.
stories.why: The parade is one of the most-watched TV traditions in the US each year.
stories.happened: The National Dog Show follows on NBC at noon. That evening CBS airs The JLO Show: Live in Las Vegas and PBS has a Paul Simon concert.
stories.next: Watch for the full balloon and performer line-up before Thursday.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The parade has been a Thanksgiving tradition for a century.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: This is the 100th edition.

stories.background: Macy's has run its New York parade since 1924. Its giant character balloons are its best-known feature.

meme.bottom: the balloons still outrank the guests
meme.take: Macy's marks 100 parades, a century of watching inflatables argue with the wind.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI's soundtrack album is out, with vinyl on the way
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album is now available to stream and buy, and a vinyl edition has been announced, DayOne reports.
stories.why: GTA's radio stations are among the best-loved parts of the series.
stories.happened: The album went live on November 20, a day after the game launched, as interest in the game peaked.
stories.next: Watch for the vinyl release date and how the album does on streaming charts.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players already know the songs from the in-game radio.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived a day after launch, while interest peaks.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto games include in-game radio stations that mix licensed songs with comedy talk shows.

meme.bottom: so now it has a vinyl
meme.take: GTA VI's soundtrack is out, for players who want the car radio without the car chase.

stories.title: Hackers used AI agents to find a zero-day in a medical imaging server, Amazon says
stories.summary: Amazon says suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find an unknown flaw in MONAI Label and take over a university server.
stories.why: It is a clear real-world case of AI agents finding new security holes, not just reusing known ones.
stories.happened: The flaw affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup and lets an attacker without an account write files outside the storage folder. BleepingComputer reports the open-source Cairn framework was used.
stories.next: Watch for a patched MONAI Label release and further reports of AI-driven attacks.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: AI agents reportedly found the flaw with no prior public knowledge of it.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Medical imaging servers hold sensitive data.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security teams warn AI is speeding up attacks.

stories.background: A zero-day is a flaw unknown to the software's makers. MONAI is an open-source toolkit for medical imaging AI.

meme.bottom: found some in a university server
meme.take: AI agents finally found a job they can do without supervision, unfortunately it was this one.

stories.title: The Rings of Power season 3 finale lands on Prime Video on November 24
stories.summary: Amazon's Lord of the Rings series ends its third season on Tuesday, a date Forbes lists as moved up.
stories.why: It is one of the most expensive TV series ever made, so its future is watched closely.
stories.happened: Forbes and NewsBeep both list the finale among the week's biggest TV events. It arrives the night before Blade Runner 2099 lands on the same service.
stories.next: Watch for news on whether Amazon orders a fourth season.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It is among the costliest TV series ever made.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Tolkien's world has a huge global fanbase.

stories.background: The series is set thousands of years before The Lord of the Rings and draws on J.R.R. Tolkien's writings.

meme.bottom: the budget remains the real dragon
meme.take: The Rings of Power ends season three, with its most powerful ring still the budget.

stories.title: Ebenezer drops 60% in its second weekend but passes $78 million worldwide
stories.summary: Johnny Depp's Christmas film made $7.7 million, down 60% from its opening, and has earned $78 million worldwide on a $38 million budget.
stories.why: Holiday films often make most of their money in December, so an early drop matters.
stories.happened: The Ti West film opened at No. 1 with $19 million in the US a week earlier. It fell to third behind the Hunger Games prequel and I Play Rocky, Flickering Myth reports.
stories.next: Watch for its hold over Thanksgiving week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Johnny Depp plays the lead.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Christmas stories usually play through December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games and I Play Rocky this weekend.

stories.background: Ebenezer is a new take on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

meme.bottom: and one Hunger Games prequel
meme.take: Scrooge has faced ghosts before, but never a franchise opening weekend.

stories.title: Twitch calls GTA VI its largest game launch ever
stories.summary: Twitch says GTA VI was its biggest game launch, with 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports. StreamCharts counted nearly 8 million in all.
stories.why: Live viewing numbers show how much of the internet stopped to watch one game come out.
stories.happened: StreamCharts' estimate covered five platforms. Riot Games said Valorant's 1.7 million viewer Twitch record had been broken. GamesRadar reports one streamer finished the game in under 40 hours without a break.
stories.next: Watch for whether viewing holds up once the story has been widely seen.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Twitch counted 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports.

drivers.label: Record
drivers.text: It beat Valorant's previous Twitch record.

drivers.label: Stamina
drivers.text: A streamer stayed up over 50 hours for a sub-40 hour run.

stories.background: Twitch is Amazon's live-streaming platform, used mostly for gaming.

meme.bottom: someone else play the game they bought
meme.take: GTA VI broke streaming records, mostly among people who also own GTA VI.

stories.title: Nintendo's winter catalogue gives a first glimpse of Pokemon Winds and Waves
stories.summary: Nintendo's Japanese Winter Catalogue includes a short description of Pokemon Winds and Waves, promising islands and a vast ocean to explore.
stories.why: Any detail about a new main Pokemon game gets picked apart by one of the biggest fan bases in gaming.
stories.happened: MyNintendoNews says the text talks about overcoming paths and forces of nature with Pokemon. The catalogue also showed Samus's suit in Metroid Ravenous. A separate rumour claims an overhauled turn-based battle system.
stories.next: Watch for an official trailer or release window from The Pokemon Company.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pokemon is the highest-earning media franchise in the world.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Sea and island settings echo earlier fan-favourite games.

stories.background: Pokemon games are made by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokemon Company.

meme.bottom: ten thousand theories
meme.take: Nintendo released two sentences about Pokemon and the fans have already written the sequel.

stories.title: Yellowjackets begins its final season on Paramount+
stories.summary: The fourth and final 10-episode season of Yellowjackets premiered on November 20, with the finale set for January 22, 2027, Forbes reports.
stories.why: The survival drama built one of streaming's most devoted fan bases, who now want answers.
stories.happened: It leads a busy streaming weekend that also includes Percy Jackson season 3 on Disney+ and Hulu and Netflix's The Altruists, about the FTX collapse. Forbes lists the Rings of Power season 3 finale as moved up to November 24.
stories.next: Watch for how the final season handles the show's long-running mysteries.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The show has a large, theory-hungry audience.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its run will stretch across the holidays into January.

drivers.label: Finale
drivers.text: It is the last season, so this is the end of the story.

stories.background: Yellowjackets follows a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness after a plane crash, and their lives 25 years later.

meme.bottom: ten episodes to answer them
meme.take: Yellowjackets has ten weeks to explain everything, which is roughly one mystery per episode.

stories.title: Peacock releases DIG, a 10-episode series led by Amy Poehler
stories.summary: All ten episodes of DIG, led by Amy Poehler, arrive on Peacock on November 23, NewsBeep's weekly schedule lists.
stories.why: A new Amy Poehler series is a draw for fans of her comedy work.
stories.happened: It opens a busy week that also includes Netflix's docuseries The Trials of Karen Read and MGM+'s New Wave. Peacock is releasing the whole season at once.
stories.next: Watch for reviews and Peacock's viewing figures.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amy Poehler leads the series.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands as viewers settle in for Thanksgiving week.

stories.background: Amy Poehler starred in Parks and Recreation and was a Saturday Night Live cast member.

meme.top: Amy Poehler has a new show
meme.bottom: and you have a four-day weekend
meme.take: Peacock drops all of DIG at once, trusting you to have no plans for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is set for November 29 on the original Switch
stories.summary: Telltale's remaster of The Wolf Among Us has an eShop date of November 29 on the original Switch, after an earlier delay.
stories.why: The 2013 game is a fan favourite, and its sequel has been long awaited.
stories.happened: My Nintendo News spotted the date on the eShop listing. Nintendo Life had reported in October that the remaster was delayed.
stories.next: Watch for versions on other platforms and news on the sequel.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original came out in 2013.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands on Thanksgiving weekend.

stories.background: The Wolf Among Us is a Telltale adventure game based on the Fables comics.

meme.bottom: arrives on a 2017 console
meme.take: The Wolf Among Us gets remastered for a console that is now a classic itself.

stories.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians season 3 premieres on Disney+
stories.summary: The third season of the Percy Jackson series arrived on Disney+ and Hulu on November 20, leading the weekend's streaming picks.
stories.why: It is one of Disney's main family franchises on streaming, adapted from a hugely popular book series.
stories.happened: Tom's Guide and Boston.com both list the premiere among the top new arrivals this weekend. It lands on the same day as the Yellowjackets final season and Netflix's animated film Steps.
stories.next: Watch for Disney's viewing figures for the premiere and any news on a fourth season.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The books have a large readership that grew up with them.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives in a crowded holiday streaming weekend.

stories.background: The series is based on Rick Riordan's novels about a boy who learns he is the son of the Greek god Poseidon.

meme.bottom: and still nobody reads the terms
meme.take: Percy Jackson is back to fight ancient gods, and also the other twelve shows out this weekend.

stories.title: Nintendo says the Zelda edition Switch 2 will be back in US stores soon
stories.summary: Nintendo's Latin America VP says the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 should return to US stock soon, Nintendo Life reports.
stories.why: Special edition consoles are in high demand before the holidays.
stories.happened: The edition has been hard to find in the US. Playable electric Zelda ocarinas will also go on sale in Europe, at first by invitation only.
stories.next: Watch for a restock date from US retailers.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Many fans missed the edition the first time.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It marks 40 years of The Legend of Zelda.

stories.background: The Legend of Zelda first came out in 1986 and is one of Nintendo's biggest series.

meme.bottom: is still hard to find, fittingly
meme.take: Nintendo says the Zelda Switch 2 returns soon, setting players their hardest quest yet.

stories.title: Capcom reveals Boat Man, the sixth Robot Master in Mega Man: Dual Override
stories.summary: Capcom has revealed Boat Man as the sixth Robot Master of Mega Man: Dual Override, due in 2027 on Switch and Switch 2.
stories.why: Mega Man is one of Capcom's oldest series, and fans have waited years for a new main game.
stories.happened: Nintendo Life reported the reveal on November 19. Boat Man is the sixth Robot Master Capcom has shown for the game.
stories.next: Watch for the remaining Robot Masters and a release date.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The series began on the NES in 1987.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans debate every new boss reveal.

stories.background: Mega Man is Capcom's action series in which the hero fights bosses called Robot Masters.

meme.top: The sixth Robot Master is here
meme.bottom: and his name is Boat Man
meme.take: Capcom named a villain Boat Man, and the series remains committed to clear job titles.

stories.title: BADBOX botnet returns on cheap Android TV boxes with 40 billion ad requests a day
stories.summary: The BADBOX malware found on generic Android TV boxes is back running ad fraud at a record 40 billion ad requests a day, BleepingComputer reports.
stories.why: Millions of cheap streaming boxes are sold online, and infected ones quietly turn homes into part of a fraud network.
stories.happened: The operation returned after disruptions last year. The malware comes on low-cost, unbranded Android TV devices and uses them to fake ad views.
stories.next: Watch for new takedown efforts and retailer action on unbranded TV boxes.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It is linked to a record 40 billion ad requests each day.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Buyers often cannot tell a box is infected.

stories.background: A botnet is a network of infected devices controlled remotely, often used for fraud or attacks.

meme.top: The cheap TV box was a bargain
meme.bottom: for the people running it
meme.take: BADBOX is back, proving some TV boxes come with more channels than advertised.

stories.title: PBS airs Paul Simon's first full live performance of Seven Psalms
stories.summary: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert airs on PBS on Thanksgiving night, billed as the first live performance of the complete Seven Psalms.
stories.why: Paul Simon is one of the best-known songwriters in American music.
stories.happened: NewsBeep lists the special for November 26 at 8 p.m. MGM+ also starts New Wave, a four-week docuseries on music from 1977 to 1987, on November 23.
stories.next: Watch for whether the concert is released as a recording.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Simon is a long-established star of American music.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is billed as the first full live performance of the piece.

stories.background: Paul Simon rose to fame in Simon and Garfunkel. Seven Psalms is a single-piece album he released in 2023.

meme.bottom: bold choice for that table
meme.take: PBS schedules a quiet celebration for the loudest dinner of the year.

stories.title: Ubisoft is down 1,100 staff in six months as it launches an AI subsidiary
stories.summary: After cutting 166 more jobs in Montreal and Quebec City, Ubisoft is down about 1,100 staff in six months and has set up an AI unit called Motherbrain.
stories.why: Players and developers worry big publishers are swapping people for AI tools.
stories.happened: Engadget says the 166 cuts in Montreal and Quebec City are mostly production and support roles tied to cancelled or reworked projects. Motherbrain focuses on AI for gameplay. Firaxis, owned by Take-Two, reportedly cut about a third of its staff the same week.
stories.next: Watch for what Motherbrain actually ships and whether more cuts follow.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Job cuts and AI investment are arriving together.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 1,100 jobs have gone in six months, GamesRadar says.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several publishers are betting on generative AI.

stories.background: Ubisoft is a French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.bottom: and named the AI Motherbrain
meme.take: Ubisoft named its AI unit Motherbrain, which is what people call the boss in games.

stats.label: staff cut in six months, reported
